title: is_tailnet_ip fe80 early-return is dead code
description: fe80::/10 is outside fc00::/7 so the explicit 'if (segs[0] & 0xffc0) == 0xfe80 { return false; }' guard is unreachable — the ULA check '(segs[0] & 0xfe00) == 0xfc00' already rejects it. The early return documents intent but misleads maintainers into thinking fe80 would otherwise pass. Either remove it or add a comment explaining it is defence-in-depth documentation only.
